name: @hivemoot/war-room
description: Shared war-room storage layer + redis-lock helper + queen-verdict primitives. Imported by web (HTTP route handlers) and bot (direct internal callers); not published to npm. The consumer's @upstash/redis and zod installs are reused by source-level resolution; this package declares them as peerDependencies (zod) and devDependencies (@upstash/redis) to avoid a dual-package hazard (two installations producing non-assignable instances).
